Prevention: Never irrigate too much as it increases the strength of the disease
Collect and remove fallen leaves and tree residues at end of the growing season.
Burn them as they can be the source of infection
Try to control aphids if you can because they can transfer the disease from tree to tree
Monitoring: May, look at the leaves of the almond trees.
Monitor the field twice a week in particular during those months
Leaves are pale green and see small spots that turn to brown and then leave a small hole in the leaf.
The leaf looks like a sieve when severely affected
When a few leaves on the tree have 2-3 holes in them, it is time to start the direct control
Direct Control: Pruning of dried and diseased shoots during the growing season
Always prevent the excessive irrigation which cause severity of the pest
Spray copper oxychloride when you see symptoms for the first time
Spray concentration of 3-4 grams per litre
Lime sulfur at 1litre per 9 litre of water
